concepts.definition: the capacity of soil to supply nutrients and suitable conditions for healthy plant growth
the planned growing of different crops on the same land in a sequence across seasons
the artificial application of water to soil or crops when rainfall is insufficient
domesticated farm animals kept for food, labour, income, or other useful products
an organism that damages crops, livestock, stored products, or farm resources
a natural or manufactured material applied to soil or plants to supply essential nutrients
the process by which a viable seed begins growth and develops into a seedling
the planning, organization, and control of farm resources to achieve production goals
the removal and transport of topsoil by water, wind, or human activity
the use of machines and mechanical power to carry out farm operations efficiently
